categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes CConnman network active lifecycle to pause and resume NAT-PMP/PCP port mapping and Tor control port connections, carrying the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Ensures -networkactive=0 fully disables background Tor control connections and NAT-PMP mapping as users expect. When -networkactive=0 is set, the node previously continued to attempt local port mapping and Tor connections, generating unintended traffic.
